## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 26, 2026 - Sep 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Magoz31_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "The calories burned are way off from what my Apple Watch says, by the HUNDREDS. I don’t for the life of me understand why it can’t sync and it is frustrating trying to even figure out. This is NOT work the price tag."
            2. _Steve Landreth_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "I am an adult paying for this app. Not a 13 year old kid using a free app on my parents phone. Quit blocking the information I use with your BS pop-ups telling me that I am using the app. It adds no value and is a time wasting obstacle interfering with my ability to use the app for the only reason I paid to use it. I will not pay again if you continue wasting my time."
            3. _9host_girl_, Sep 26, 2026, 1/5: "Now I won’t have any extra money for my birthday. It could take a while for the refund request to Apple to go through, so it most likely won’t be solved in time, as my birthday is tomorrow. Very sad and deleting the app now. I was using it to help me gain weight and track my calories, since I’ve been stressed and lost weight. I’ve had this app for a long time, and used it in the past to maintain weight, but this experience has ruined it for me honestly. It’s just too high of a charge for forgetting to cancel a free trial & not worth all this extra stress"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Sep 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kaspar Lee_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "Literally a million settings and no setting for this, always getting random notifications at random times to try and get me back on the app, zero setting to turn off. Also app is quite buggy and over complicated."
            2. _IXE_04_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The app used to be way better. The UI is confusing, jumbled, and overall just horrible compared to the old one not to mention it glitches and lags way more now. figure it out!"
            3. _RuachOo_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "The app has become so bloated over the years its extremely slow, and the unnecessary praising and popups is super annoying. Less clicks = better experience. It also often just freezes for 10seconds before responding again when i open the app"
